title: TutorTurn
description: Structured generation response schema for Archimedes the Owl

speech.description: The exact tutor reply to the student. Must be between 150 and 300 characters, ending with exactly one question mark. No lists, no emoji.

usedPoolIndex.description: 0-based index of the probe from allowedContent.pool if chosen or paraphrased, otherwise null.

understanding.description: Classification of child understanding during the Understand stage.

unknown.description: True if child understands what is to be found.

data.description: True if child identifies the givens/facts.

condition.description: True if child recognizes the rule, constraint, or relationship.

studentSignal.description: Advisory telemetry on student engagement state.

suggestCard.description: Name of a heuristic card recommended to the student at rung l1 or higher, if applicable.
